product.name: Marriott Bonvoy Bevy American Express Card

benefits.name: Free Night Award after $15,000 spend
benefits.notes: Earned after $15,000 of purchases in a calendar year, so it is reported as unlockable rather than available (SPEC §4.7) — the app does not track spend and cannot assume the threshold is met.
benefits.estimate_basis: Award redeemable at hotels costing up to 50,000 Marriott Bonvoy points, valued at 0.8 cents per point per The Points Guy July 2026 valuations. This is the award ceiling, not a typical redemption — record what the room actually cost to replace it.
benefits.merchant_scope: One night at a participating hotel with a redemption level at or under 50,000 points

benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status
benefits.notes: Complimentary Gold Elite status while the card is open, plus 15 Elite Night Credits each calendar year. No dollar value is tracked.
